fields.statement: Change set 01M75R7 (CI infra outage leaves a run failed): ship-change already sends an infra-only red (no failing test) from ci-triage to wait-ci-rerun, but that wait only passes once someone else reruns CI or pushes, and plan/plan-milestone have no infra path at all (pr-green/rebased-green just end after --reruns 2). How should a run ride out a sustained outage? / Should ship-change's post-land green steps (landed-green, rebased-merge-green), which today send an infra red through conflict-triage-landed and rebase-merge-gate-failed to the end of the run, get the same infra wait in this change set?
